title: QuizyStream
tagline: Real time token streaming quiz game platform that allows based earning

prizes.placement: Best use of Blockscout Block Explorer
prizes.title: Best use of Blockscout Block Explorer

description:
Our project is a quiz Game that connects organizations and players . All players are streamed tokens in real time at the beginning with an equal share. Depending on their performance over each question, their stream rewards ratio changes over time . 
At the end , the top 3 people are paid an additional lump sum amount.
how_its_made:
To enter the arena,user enters the room id, they don't need to know web3  as we give option to enter email id and make transactions using dynamic.
We ensure that each player is a human by using worldcoin id .
We are streaming ApeX(Ape coin wrapped tokens) tokens to users on real time basis.

To stream payments in real time , we use superfluid's GDA contracts to manage their ratio depending on their answer.
